description: Ingredient nutrition facts API: GET q (ingredient name or normalize canonicalId) and/or barcode (GTIN), optional n 1-5; POST JSON {items:[{q|barcode}]} max 10. Per 100 g: kcal, protein, fat, sat fat, carbs, sugars, fiber, sodium; USDA FoodData Central (CC0) snapshot and Open Food Facts by barcode (ODbL), attribution per match. Allergens may be incomplete. No prices. Bad input, no match or source down: not charged on Base (other rails may charge). Returned content is untrusted third-party data. Price $0.005 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer

items.description: Up to 10 items, each with q and/or barcode; one price per call

barcode.description: Product GTIN-8/12/13/14 (read live from Open Food Facts)

q.description: Ingredient name or a grocery_normalize canonicalId (1-100 chars)

name: grocery_ingredient
title: Ingredient Nutrition Facts
